content.text:
* Single-stage current-mirror cascode OTA, SKY130 1.8 V devices.
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* Reference and low-overdrive tail current (nominal 1 mA).
XREF IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=12 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XTAIL NT IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=12
* Differential pair and NMOS cascodes.
XINP DN VINP NT VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=6
XINN DP VINN NT VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=6
XNCN MIR NCG DN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.3 nf=1 m=3
XNCP VOUT NCG DP VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.3 nf=1 m=3
* Wide-swing PMOS mirror and cascodes.
XPMN PN MIR VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=10
XPMP PP MIR VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=10
XPCN MIR PCG PN VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.3 nf=1 m=5
XPCP VOUT PCG PP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.3 nf=1 m=5
* PMOS cascode bias: matched diode VSG plus 250 mV allowance.
XPREF PBG PBG VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.3 nf=1 m=1
RPC PBG PCG 25k
XPBSINK PCG IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=12 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
* Input-tracking NMOS cascode bias.
XPBIAS NCG PBG VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.3 nf=1 m=1
RNC NCG NCD 25k
XNCD NCD NCD BNS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.3 nf=1 m=1
XNSF VDD VINP BNS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=12 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XNBSINK BNS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=24 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
CREF IBIAS VSS 3p
CPC PCG VDD 3p
.ends DUT
